I am an Anglo-American writer and artist based in Scotland. My work is founded on global experience in aerospace, technology and education. In recent years, I have been exploring storytelling as our natural and most effective means to sustain and develop ourselves. Humans co-evolved their cognitive capacity with the cultural. At the heart of who we are lies the art of external representation of memory, whether in mimesis or invention. We are time-travellers. If you need proof of that, think back. Find a moment when you were younger, and picture it. What do your senses tell you? Can you picture a moment in your future?

My present principal project is a monograph containing the fictionalised analysis and representation of research into the use of audio pedagogy.
